phase1_leaf_result.new_narrowing: Content-addressed Git object identity proves identity/authenticity of available object bytes under the non-collision model but is not self-remembering freshness state. There are 36 strict current-domain indistinguishability pairs when no external witness or only a same-repository pointer exists. A surviving bare SHA can break identity symmetry only by surviving in a third durable domain and still lacks intrinsic generation order when ancestry cannot be checked. A surviving generation+SHA record proves freshness only because the independent durable domain carries ordering metadata.
minimal_unresolved_children: A zero-cost Chat-native non-rollbackable recovery witness independent of repository+sink common-mode rollback remains unproven.
Bare SHA survival without durable ordering/ancestry metadata is identity-only evidence.
Same-repository unreachable-object retention is not a generic permanent guarantee because unreachable objects can be pruned.
Part128 repository-incarnation write-time fencing remains unresolved.
